dots.field: after the republic referendum of 6 November 1999

events.l: Nationals decline to renew Coalition agreement
events.t: David Littleproud announces that the Nationals will sit separately after the election defeat. The parties reach a new agreement on 28 May.
Joyce defects to One Nation – the first sitting MP defection from the major-party bloc to ONP.
A shooting at Bondi Beach in Sydney.
Replaces Sussan Ley as Leader of the Liberal Party and Opposition Leader.
Closure during Iran war triggers an Australian fuel crisis.
Treasurer Jim Chalmers delivers the Albanese government’s fifth federal budget, rated, according to Newspoll, as the worst for the economy since 1993.
The Reserve Bank raises the cash-rate target to its highest level in 15 years.
The Reserve Bank raises the cash-rate target to its highest level in 18 years.
